verses.4: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
verses.6: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.
verses.7: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.
verses.8: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.
verses.9: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
verses.10: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
verses.11: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
verses.12: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith,
verses.13: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.
verses.14: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
verses.16: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
verses.23: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.
verses.24: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
verses.25: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.

verses.31: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
